items.headline: Patrick Mahomes says he is on track to start Week 1 after ACL/LCL recovery
items.detail: Mahomes has progressed through training camp and publicly expects to start against Denver. Because QB value is modeled separately, his expected participation and any mobility/limitations remain a material Week 1 input.
items.bettingImpact: Potentially major if status deteriorates; current evidence materially reduces the probability of a backup-QB scenario.
items.modelTreatment: Do not apply a full injury downgrade while Mahomes remains on track. Maintain a recovery uncertainty band until final practice/medical evidence.

items.headline: Atlanta Week 1 starter remains unresolved between Michael Penix Jr. and Tua Tagovailoa
items.detail: Penix has been medically cleared for full 11-on-11 work and has split first-team reps with Tagovailoa. Falcons coaches say the Week 1 starter decision is still being evaluated.
items.bettingImpact: Material because the two quarterbacks require different expected-efficiency, pressure and mobility assumptions.
items.modelTreatment: Keep ATL fair line provisional until starter probability is assigned; calculate separate Penix-start and Tagovailoa-start scenarios rather than averaging blindly.

items.headline: 49ers-Rams will be played at Melbourne Cricket Ground in the NFL's Australia debut
items.detail: The divisional matchup is officially scheduled in Melbourne rather than Los Angeles, creating an extreme travel/time-zone environment for both teams.
items.bettingImpact: Requires neutral-site home-field removal plus travel/rest uncertainty. The effect should not be guessed as a generic international-game adjustment.
items.modelTreatment: Treat as neutral venue and calibrate an international travel adjustment from historical long-haul games where possible.
